name: gx6605s-exploratory
description: Functional bring-up profile. Reset values and completion timing are hypotheses, not receiver measurements.
assumptions: Documented GCTL configuration registers start at zero and provide configuration readback; reset values, reset propagation and clock side effects are not verified on the StarSat board.
DRAM initialization completes immediately after the controller START bit is written; no analog training or timing.
SPI flash is a read-only virtual NOR populated from the update payload; omitted device data remains erased.
RTC starts with zeroed configuration and counters, and advances ten virtual microseconds per guest instruction; calendar rollover and alarms are not modeled.
IRQ/FIQ configuration starts at zero and no external interrupt sources are asserted.
Infrared receiver starts idle and receives no external remote-control frames.
A synthetic zero-filled 2 KiB OTP store is exposed through a read-only protocol inferred from the bootloader; real device fuses and secrets are unavailable.
Virtual NOR reports W25Q32-class JEDEC ef4016; this is an emulated part selection, not identification of the receiver flash.
VPU registers provide configuration storage with assumed zero reset values; no video processing or scan timing. Assumed reads are listed in reports.
Undocumented GCTL offset 0xA04, accessed by the bootloader, is modeled as zero-initialized configuration storage.
The read-only auxiliary information word at 0x00F8000C is zero for the synthetic chip; the bootloader extracts bits 11..13 as a configuration selector. This is not a measured receiver value.
Specifically listed provisional registers provide storage/readback only; their hardware side effects are unmodeled and every use is recorded.
External GPIO inputs are held high to represent an idle virtual board; actual receiver button/pull levels have not been measured.
Uninitialized VPU registers in 0x04800140..0x048001BC stop explicitly because the firmware uses this block in payload decoding; their values cannot be inferred from the image.
